chunks: What Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad narrated from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from more than one of our companions, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Salat (prayer) in the ship is by gesture.

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: the Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام as the source of the ruling
key_terms.إِيمَاءٌ: performing the prayer by indication or gesture rather than full bodily motions
key_terms.السَّفِينَةِ: a ship or vessel in which the worshipper is traveling or situated

ai.seo_question: How should salat (prayer) be performed on a ship according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about performing salat (prayer) while on a ship. It indicates that in this setting, the prayer is performed through gesturing, reflecting practical accommodation in worship under constrained circumstances.
